Hi Nathan — thanks for the clear list. Opening the thread internally so we can be prescriptive.

Short answer: yes, please prepare a single evidence bundle. See the checklist below — if you can deliver those artifacts we can start the technical validation and SKU-mapping in parallel.

Required technical/compliance artifacts (minimal viable set):
- SOC2 Type II report (redacted acceptable)
- Data flow diagram showing customer data ingress/egress and where inference occurs
- Encryption at rest/in-transit description (algorithms, KMS details)
- List of third-party subprocessors and data retention policy
- A small sample deployment manifest (Helm chart or Terraform snippet) showing how your model is hosted and scaled
- Lightweight security contact + SOC2 auditor contact info

SKU/entitlement inputs we need for marketplace mapping:
- Primary product name, priced unit (e.g., vCPU-hour, token, seat), MSRP, and suggested minimum SKU (three tiers preferred)
- Any trial/credit configuration you want on the cloud marketplaces

Timeline and next steps:
- If we get the bundle by EOD Nov 23 we can start review on Nov 24 and aim to return initial feedback by Nov 30.
- Parallel action: Karthik will scope the entitlement/metering mapping with Marketplace teams. Ben — can you help with GTM enablement and ask Marissa for partner-facing collateral support?

I'll stitch this into a short mutual action plan once we have the bundle.

Thanks,
Olga
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference

Olga — thanks. From a go-to-market lens, the things that accelerate co-sell are:
- A one-pager GTM play (target customer personas, 3 messaging bullets, 2 pilot case studies)
- A clear SKU map and a suggested sell-through discount cadence for the first 90 days
- A short enablement deck (10 slides) for our field sellers and partner reps

Marissa — would you own a first-draft enablement deck based on Zephyr's GTM playbook once they share it? We should also get a short list of 4-6 SEs to shadow early co-sell calls.

Nathan — if you can include a quick pilot customer reference and the GTM one-pager with the evidence bundle, we can fast-track the marketplace listing and the co-sell readiness review.
